us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: News outlets ask court to block White House grounds ban
bullets: Three outlets sought a federal block on the White House ban.
They said enforcement continued despite a judge’s restraining order.
CNN’s White House pool access was cited in the filing.

articles.title: Jack Smith to tell senators he will not be silenced
bullets: Former special counsel Jack Smith is appearing before senators Tuesday.
He prosecuted two federal cases against Donald Trump.
Smith plans to warn that rule of law is under threat.

articles.title: Two Navy aviators eject during carrier landing off Virginia
bullets: Two aviators ejected during recovery operations on a carrier.
The Navy said search-and-rescue crews recovered both aviators.
Four sailors were injured in the incident.

articles.title: Hegseth says military cyber forces will guard midterm systems
bullets: National security and military cyber teams will help protect elections.
The announcement comes ahead of the 2026 midterms.
Officials framed the move as election-system defense.

articles.title: Trump announces planned $15 billion Iowa steel plant
bullets: Trump said the plant would be among the nation’s largest.
The announcement highlighted Iowa before competitive midterm races.
Trump credited steel tariffs for industry investment.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Iran says Trump’s war has failed in message to Americans
bullets: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard spokesman addressed the US public Tuesday.
He read what he called a letter to Americans.
The remarks came amid continuing Middle East tensions.

articles.title: Russia launches missiles and jet-powered drones at Kyiv
bullets: Ukraine’s air force reported ballistic missiles and dozens of drones.
Kyiv remains under pressure from day-and-night bombardment.
Moscow is escalating attacks on the capital and other cities.

articles.title: UN envoy meets Houthi negotiators to curb Yemen escalation
bullets: The UN envoy said he met Houthi negotiators over the weekend.
Talks aimed to avert further violence in Yemen.
Fierce battles continue on Yemen’s western coast.

articles.title: Vietnam arrests three on terrorism charges
bullets: Vietnam detained three people, including Norwegian and Australian-linked suspects.
Authorities said they were arrested trying to cross a border.
A pro-democracy group disputed aspects of the operation.

articles.title: Russia raises 2027 military spending, documents show
bullets: Reuters reported Russia plans a 27% military-spending increase.
The report cited budget documents reviewed by Reuters.
The increase comes during continued war with Ukraine.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Toddler killed after school bus runs over her in Mysuru
bullets: A 1-year-7-month-old girl died in Mysuru district.
Police received a complaint against the school vehicle driver.
The family alleged rash and negligent driving.

articles.title: First bullet-train steel bridge installed in Maharashtra
bullets: The steel bridge was launched at Dive-Anjur in Bhiwandi.
It was transported more than 1,000 kilometers before installation.
The structure spans National Highway 3.
articles.source: NDTV Profit / Press Trust of India

articles.title: India IT stocks fall as sector weakness continues
bullets: TCS, Wipro, Infosys and HCL Tech traded lower.
NDTV Profit reported IT shares fell up to 2%.
The sector is down sharply year-to-date.

articles.title: Former UP IAS officer Divya Mittal enters politics
bullets: Divya Mittal announced her entry into politics.
She ruled out joining any political party for now.
Her resignation from the IAS was accepted in September.

articles.title: Indian rupee falls past 96 per dollar on oil worries
bullets: The rupee touched a two-month low past 96 per dollar.
Rising oil prices pressured India’s import-sensitive economy.
Foreign investors have pulled billions from Indian assets this month.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: US market movers and market action

articles.title: US stock futures edge higher as oil dips
bullets: AP reported US futures were slightly higher Tuesday morning.
Oil prices eased after recent supply-driven gains.
Bond yields remained near historically high levels.

articles.title: Wall Street fell Monday as yields pressured indexes
bullets: Major US indexes ended lower on September 28.
High bond yields pulled stocks further from records.
AP said the move followed renewed rate-path uncertainty.

articles.title: Summit Therapeutics leads premarket gainers
bullets: Summit Therapeutics rose about 17% in premarket trading.
PremarketPrice listed it as Tuesday’s top gainer.
The move came in healthcare shares before the open.

articles.title: Fair Isaac drops sharply in premarket trading
bullets: Fair Isaac was the biggest listed premarket decliner.
The stock fell about 9.6% before the open.
PremarketPrice flagged the move as unusually large.

articles.title: MongoDB trades higher after earnings release
bullets: MongoDB gained modestly in premarket trading.
PremarketPrice cited an earnings-release catalyst.
The stock showed elevated relative volume.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: FAA delay hits Boeing 737 MAX 10 certification
bullets: The FAA delayed certification of Boeing’s 737 MAX 10.
A newly disclosed software issue must be resolved first.
Reuters reported Boeing shares fell after the setback.

articles.title: Toyota sales and production fall for second month
bullets: Toyota’s August global sales fell 6.4% year over year.
Production dropped 5.9%, Reuters reported Tuesday.
Weakness in China, the US and Middle East weighed on results.

articles.title: Codan shares hit record after profit forecast
bullets: Codan forecast first-half profit of at least A$160 million.
The estimate more than doubles last year’s comparable profit.
The Australian electronics company’s shares reached a record high.

articles.title: Legrand raises mid-term targets on data-center growth
bullets: Legrand lifted medium-term targets, Reuters reported.
Data-center demand is supporting the company’s outlook.
The update came amid strong electrification infrastructure spending.

articles.title: Evonik rejects BASF’s $11.7 billion bid, sources say
bullets: Reuters reported Evonik rejected BASF’s proposal.
The bid was valued at about $11.7 billion.
The report cited sources familiar with the matter.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Technology and AI news from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: OpenAI delays latest model over security concerns
bullets: OpenAI delayed a new model because of security concerns.
The decision comes amid rising pressure on AI safety.
AI executives are set to meet Trump in Washington.

articles.title: Pope Leo says AI safety concerns are not fake news
bullets: Pope Leo XIV said AI risks should be taken seriously.
He urged discussion and action on safety concerns.
His comments contradicted Trump’s framing, AP reported.

articles.title: Anthropic and OpenAI shape debate over AI controls
bullets: AP examined AI companies’ warnings about advanced systems.
Anthropic and OpenAI are influencing control-policy debates.
The report highlighted questions about industry incentives.

articles.title: Anthropic rolls out second Claude 5.5 model
bullets: Reuters reported Anthropic launched a second Claude 5.5 model.
The rollout comes as the company builds toward an IPO.
AI spending and safety remain central investor issues.

articles.title: Dutch ‘reformed hacker’ arrested in ShinyHunters probe
bullets: Dutch police arrested a person tied to a ShinyHunters investigation.
Reuters identified the suspect as a self-described reformed hacker.
The case concerns cybercrime activity linked to the hacking group.
